title: [finding] sheet.tsx's undeclared `hideOverlay` prop has zero consumers, so the type-check gate credited with catching its loss is vacuous today
body:
Fell out of #6027 while writing the docblock record of "which gate catches each undeclared local edit". Recording only — nothing is broken today.

## Fact

#6027's table credits `hideOverlay` with a **loud** failure mode:

| file | undeclared local edit | what a `--force` sync does |
|---|---|---|
| `sheet.tsx` | `hideOverlay` prop suppressing `<SheetOverlay />` | drops it → call sites fail to type-check (**loud**) |

That reasoning requires call sites. Measured on `main` (`7c96c9420`), there are none. Every occurrence of the identifier in the tree:

```
packages/components/src/ui/sheet.tsx:64:  hideOverlay?: boolean
packages/components/src/ui/sheet.tsx:70:>(({ side = "right", className, children, hideOverlay, ...props }, ref) => (
packages/components/src/ui/sheet.tsx:72:    {!hideOverlay && <SheetOverlay />}
packages/components/shadcn-components.json:272:   ... "localEdits": "Adds a `hideOverlay` prop ..."
ROADMAP.md:485,486
scripts/__tests__/shadcn-local-patches.test.ts:151,157  (prose about the edit, not a use)
```

No `<SheetContent …>` in the repo passes it. `ROADMAP.md:486` credits `DesignDrawer` (`modal={false}` + `hideOverlay` so preview widgets stay clickable while the drawer is open) — **no `DesignDrawer*` file exists** anywhere in the tree.

## Why it matters

`hideOverlay` is an **optional** prop. With no consumer passing it, a `--force` sync that drops it from `sheet.tsx` type-checks clean: nothing references the removed member. So of the four undeclared local edits #6027 enumerated, the count that no gate catches is **two**, not one — the Tailwind v4 spelling (now guarded by #6027's assertion) and this one.

The difference in severity is real and worth stating: losing the Tailwind migration ships invalid CSS to users, whereas losing `hideOverlay` currently removes an API nobody calls. This is a **stale gate attribution**, not a live user-facing defect — which is exactly why it is worth recording rather than fixing blind.

The gate re-arms by itself the moment anything passes the prop.

## Options worth weighing (not asserting a direction)

- **Retire it** — an undeclared local edit maintained against upstream drift, serving zero consumers, is pure carrying cost; the ROADMAP entry describing its consumer is already stale. Cheapest, and consistent with removing declared-but-unconsumed surface.
- **Declare it** as a patch family in `scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs` — one small anchor (unlike the ~20-string Tailwind case #6027 declined), which would make its loss loud independently of whether a consumer exists.
- **Leave it and correct the record** — fix `ROADMAP.md`'s stale `DesignDrawer` claim and #6027's table, accepting that the edit is unguarded until a consumer returns.

Deciding between these is a judgement about whether the prop still has a future, which I have no basis to make from here.

Filed unassigned, `finding` only, no `pm:queue` — observation class, for PM triage.

Refs: #6027 (the assertion whose docblock records this caveat) · #4996.
